jobs.prompt: Create a polished replacement illustration for a coaching slide. Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the overriding CHARACTER STYLE reference: rounded anonymous featureless oval heads, no nose/chin/ears, simple softly curved grey bodies, minimal anatomy, light grey flat fill and clean thin medium-grey contours, no clothing seams, no gender cues. Image 2 is the old illustration: preserve its conceptual scene but REDESIGN it in the simpler character style of Image 1. Elegant restrained editorial line illustration, generous whitespace, pure #FFFFFF background edge to edge. Small flat green #54B570 accents only where meaningful. No 3D, no realism, no texture, no gradients, no frames, no decorative scenery. Wide 16:9 composition, comfortably contained with 8% margins. Scene: a single generic figure at the left calmly considering three simple equal-height pillars, representing three fixed commitments. Retain the three exact labels 'Shape', 'Sequence', 'Terms', each directly centered over its own pillar and clearly separated. Pale grey pillars, restrained green cap accents. Figure has a relaxed open hand gesture. Keep airy balanced spacing.
